title: InstancesPost
description:
InstancesPost represents the fields required to launch a new instance for
a specific application

addons.description: Addons to enable for the instance

app_id.description: ID of the application to use. Can be empty if an image ID is specified instead

app_version.description: Version of the application to use. If not specified, the latest version is used.

boot_activity.description: BootActivity specifies the Android activity which is started by default

boot_package.description: BootPackage specifies the Android application package name which is started by default

devmode.description: DevMode specifies if development mode has been turned on for the instance

disable_watchdog.description: DisableWatchdog defines whether the watchdog is disabled

display.description: Display specifies the configuration of the virutal display of the instance

density.description: Density is the piel density of the virtual display

fps.description: FPS is the frame rate of the virtual display

height.description: Height is the height of the virtual display

width.description: Width is the width of the virtual display

enable_streaming.description: EnableStreaming specifies if streaming should be enabled for the instance or not

features.description: Feature flags to enable for the instance.

metrics_server.description: MetricsServer specifies a metrics server the instance will use

platform.description: Platform specifies the Anbox platform the instance is running with

image_id.description: ID of the image to use. Can be empty if an application ID is specified instead.

image_version.description: Version of the image to use. If not specified, the latest version is used.

name.description:
Name of the instance. Will be automatically assigned if not specified. Names
must be unique.

no_start.description: Do not start the instance after creation.

node.description: Node to start the instance on. If empty node will be automatically selected.

resources.description: Resources specifies the resources allocated for the instance

cpus.description: Number of CPU cores the instance should get assigned.

disk_size.description: Disk size the instance should get allocated in bytes

gpu-slots.description: Number of GPU slots the instance should get assigned.

memory.description: Memory the instance should get assigned in bytes.

vpu-slots.description: Number of VPU slots the instance should get assigned

services.description: Services to enable for the instance

tags.description: Tags which will be assigned to the instance

user_data.description: User data to pass to the instance.

InstanceType.description: InstanceType describes the type of an instance (container, vm)

NetworkProtocol.description: NetworkProtocol describes a specific network protocol like TCP or UDP a ContainerService can use

NetworkServiceSpec.description: NetworkServiceSpec is used to define the user defined network services that should be opened on a container

expose.description:
Expose defines wether the service is exposed on the public endpoint of the node
or if it is only available on the private endpoint. To expose the service set to
true and to false otherwise.

name.description:
Name gives the container a hint what the exposed port is being used for. This
allows further tweaks inside the container to expose the service correctly.
Exampe: ssh

port.description: Port is the port the container provides a service on

port_end.description:
PortEnd is the end of the port range set for a service. If empty, only a
single port is opened

protocols.description: List of network protocols (tcp, udp) the port should be exposed for
